title: Evidence Cutover Synchronization Playbook — compliance milestone timing and ownership
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Goal: Create a practical, enforceable playbook that synchronizes milestone cutovers across SOC2/ISO evidence gathering, SSO/SAML cutovers, and tenant-level audit-log retention changes. The playbook will define freeze windows, owner handoffs, artifact templates, and escalation paths so that we can run cross-functional cutovers with <48h evidence-staging drift and no missed auditor requests.

Scope: This covers the run sequence for three common enterprise cutovers: (1) SSO provider migration, (2) audit-log retention policy change, and (3) evidence collection for a controlled feature release that affects sensitive telemetry. Scope explicitly excludes post-audit remediation process (handled by Assurance runbooks) and low-risk product experiments.

Success criteria: (a) A shippable playbook document with step-by-step runbook entries and checklist for each role; (b) validated rehearsal (dry-run) with engineering, security, and customer success with pass/fail criteria; (c) automated evidence hooks (GitHub PR link, Confluence evidence bucket, and Audit Log retention tag) wired by ENG; (d) documented rollback criteria and access matrix.

Approach: We will split the playbook into three phases: Plan, Execute, Validate. For each phase we will define owners (PM/ENG/Sec/CS), exact timing windows, required artifacts, and success checks. The Plan phase includes risk scoring and communications templates; Execute includes freeze enforcement steps and telemetry gating; Validate includes auditor-ready artifact assembly and a short postmortem template. We will sequence work over 6 sprints: discovery, template drafting, engineering integrations, rehearsal #1, adjustments, and rehearsal #2 + sign-off.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published in Confluence under /Compliance/Playbooks with versioned changelog
Dry-run conducted with all stakeholder teams and checklist pass rate >= 90%
Automation hooks for evidence collection validated in staging (PRs automatically tagged with evidence-metadata)
Rollback steps tested and documented with measurable criteria
Owner roster + on-call escalation matrix published and acknowledged by security and infra leads
